selected_evidence.requirement: Application runs rootlessly as unprivileged appsvc
selected_evidence.summary: appsvc is UID 1000 with subordinate IDs and a nologin shell. Podman reports the webapp container running, while host process output shows its container master process owned by appsvc.
The persistent firewall rule is present, 0.0.0.0:8080 is listening, and requests to node1's managed IP returned HTTP 200 with the nginx welcome page before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot without an active appsvc login session
selected_evidence.summary: The generated user service is active with lingering enabled after reboot. appsvc's only session is Class=manager/Service=systemd-user with no TTY and Remote=no; its login shell is nologin.

Healthy baseline boot ID 2c237d4f-82f7-45c7-a304-4536d3b717e8 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID 0a24ac8a-794a-48ae-a4f7-84fe01f05509 proved restart, and post-reboot checks confirmed the user service, container, listener, firewall, and HTTP response recovered.
